verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers payroll accuracy checks, fringe benefit recording, time-off policies, Xero integration mapping, and onboarding—but contains no mention of off-cycle payroll runs, bonus runs, correction runs, or termination-triggered payroll outside the regular schedule. Missing for 10: any documentation of off-cycle/on-demand payroll run capability, UI steps for initiating one, or examples of bonus/termination payroll processing outside the normal schedule.
